$description: Sweat Strategies design tokens. Lifted from sweatstrategies.com (sweat-website: src/css/global.css, header.css, main.css) via the 2026 deck system. W3C Design Tokens format — imports into Figma via Tokens Studio, and generates system/tokens.css via scripts/build-tokens.mjs.

black.$description: The ground. Every surface starts here.

paper.$description: The one light surface. Inverts type to black.

head.$description: Site h1 / footer display colour. A head set in this reads quieter than white without going grey.

blue.$description: The accent. Brackets, kickers, figures, highlight fills.

blue-bright.$description: Third blur field only — never type.

mono.$description: Labels only, always uppercase, always tracked out. The site uses Cousine off Google Fonts; this stack falls back to a system mono so nothing breaks offline.

display.$description: The signature. Display type is tight enough that it reads as one mass.

label.$description: Mono labels track out, never in.

size.$description: Authored against the 1920px reference canvas. In CSS each is multiplied by --u, so the same numbers hold at any ad size.

figure.$description: Headline numerals. Always blue, always tabular.

space.$description: Also against the 1920 canvas and also scaled by --u.

pad.$description: The frame gutter. Nothing crosses it but full-bleed imagery.

grain.$description: Film grain over the ground. PJ: "black grainy".

blur-field.$description: Colour blur radius. Does not scale with --u — a blur is an optical amount, not a layout one.

blur-reveal.$description: Text resolving out of blur, as the site's scroll reveal.

perspective.$description: Long enough that a card turns hard but still lies flat.

reference.$description: Every size above is authored here. --u = canvas width / 1920.
